title: Pariyerum Perumal BA.BL
desc: A law student develops a friendship with a girl from another caste. However, things take a turn when men from her family confront him over the relationship.

title: Naan Local
desc: Babu, a carefree graduate, falls in love with Keerthy, his classmate, and pursues a relationship with her. However, her father doesn't approve of their union and wants her to marry a successful man.

title: Saakini Daakini
desc: Two police trainees set out on a dangerous mission in order to investigate the kidnapping of a girl from a nightclub when they fail to get the police's help.

desc: A wall creates discord between two factions of a political party. Kaali and his friend Anbu, who is a political aspirant, get embroiled in the brutal political rivalry.

desc: A happy-go-lucky man is forced to adopt violent means to avenge his parents' ruthless murders. So, with the help of his love, he sets out to punish the culprits.

title: Oh My Ghost
desc: Gemini said When a woman and her friends reach a small town, they uncover a link to a ghost and realise their grandfather left behind a secret legacy that changes their lives forever.

desc: Nandu, a student, attends a wedding. However, things turn chaotic when the bride's father seeks protection from him, which threatens to reveal Nandu's past.

desc: A dreaded prisoner serving a death sentence for murder is shifted to another judicial custody manned by a strict jailer. Things take a turn when he tries to escape the prison.

desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Ponmagal Vandhal
desc: Venba, a brave lawyer, takes on a case in an attempt to fight against a society hiding behind the shadows of male chauvinism.

title: Nenjamundu Nermaiyundu Odu Raja
desc: Youngsters Shiva and Vicky earn a living making videos on a digital platform and prank Jeepakaran, a businessman. However, Jeepakaran asks them to work for him in return for money.

title: Siruthai

title: Kalyana Vaibhogam
desc: A man with strong traditional values falls in love with a woman, and they decide to get married, until the groom and the bride's father have a difference of opinion about marriage.

title: Kalvan
desc: Kemban abandons his adopted grandfather in a forest to die at the hands of an animal, so that he would be compensated by the forest department. But the old man keeps surviving, which annoys Kemban.

title: Ruler
desc: A businesswoman adopts a stranger who saves her life and raises him as her son. However, the young man has a dark past that catches up with him despite his mother's attempts to shield him from it.
